source.prompt: Video lane, arms-swap recipe (owner reject 2026-08-09: 手が交差していない — the generic walk prompt let wan keep one hand permanently in front). Stage 1 stand: template `avatar-stand` (2026-08-09): A single full-body chibi girl game character, MapleStory-like 2D side-scroller style matching the reference image exactly (same line weight, soft cel shading, cute proportions, ~3-head-tall). Soft black bob haircut with a small red hairclip on the near side, large shiny eyes, light blush, gentle smile. Wearing a soft SKY-BLUE sleeveless camisole top that fully covers the chest and clearly reads as clothing (NOT skin-colored, NOT white, NOT bare — a distinctly blue inner top), soft cream shorts, and simple dark brown shoes. Facing right in 3/4 view, standing idle with arms relaxed at the sides, feet together on an invisible ground line. Flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background, no shadow, no ground, no props, no text. Centered, character fills most of the frame vertically. Stage 2 walk video: wan-2.7-i2v with template `avatar-walk-i2v-arms` (arms MUST TRADE PLACES every step, relaxed elbows, no motion blur) + vars.colorNotes locking skin/camisole/shorts/shoe colors — wan repaints pale skin and pastel garments otherwise (5 takes measured: gray camisole x2 caught by the interior palette-drift lint, pink/yellow limbs x2 caught visually, the adopted clip is take 5 of the arms recipe). Frame selection: drift-aware stride scan over the whole clip — contact anchors from the foot-phase autocorrelation (fundamental period 12 @30fps), quarter-phase spacing, per-slot PHASE-EQUIVALENT substitution (±k*period, ±1 jitter) when a slot's frame fails the head/drift checks. Committed cells: stand + clip frames frame_0086 (contact, near arm swung back) / frame_0089 (passing) / frame_0092 (opposite contact, arm forward) / frame_0107 (opposite passing — phase-EXACT +1-stride substitution for the drifted frame_0094..0096 band; owner round 2 caught that an earlier hand-picked substitute, frame_0072 from a different stride, was ~1 frame off phase and read as a second contact — walk-a ≈ walk-d with no midpoint. Cross-stride substitutes must be exactly ±k×period from the failing slot, which is what cycle_scan.py automates). Head composite: the stand head erase-then-pasted at each frame's structural neck. Rejected en route: a mirror-cycle construction (contact+passing mirrored for the opposite half) — perfect color/phase but the 3/4-view lighting and camisole strap flip every half stride and strobe (videoReview fail 2026-08-09).
